sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven officer in a nearly frontal three-quarter view slightly toward screen-left, stern quiet closed mouth, short dark brown hair visible around the cap and dark eyebrows. Smooth bare upper lip, cheeks/jaw/chin with no moustache or beard. Gray-brown peaked cap with rust-red/orange band, brown leather strap, gray visor and tall central gold badge with a crown/wreath-like shape; keep tiny details as source shapes rather than invented insignia. Brown-gray military coat, long rust-red collar tabs with narrow pale-gold decorations, shoulder tabs and small gold buttons; muted pale blue-green closed shirt with a light gray tie. Retain source crop, lighting and complete pale gray-cream painted background, with short broad mascot neck and naturally adapted collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up male officer almost front-facing with gaze slightly toward screen-left and a composed serious closed mouth. Short tightly curled black hair visible beneath a broad plain olive peaked cap with a glossy black visor/band and no visible front badge. Strong dark brows and a thick black upper-lip moustache only; keep jaw and chin bare without a beard. Olive military tunic with a high folded/standing collar, thin pale inner shirt edge, central gold button, gold buttoned shoulder straps and a dark leather strap descending from screen-right shoulder. Preserve exact hat shape, strap, pose, lighting and continuous pale gray-green painted rectangular backing; compact yellow mascot head with moustache/hair retained and a short broad neck fitted into the same collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up female officer turned slightly toward screen-right with a serious closed-mouth expression, full dark natural eyebrows, smooth bare upper lip and chin and dense short rounded black afro hair, broader on screen-left and much lower than the separate tall-afro source. No hat, eyewear or facial hair. Blue-gray high-collared buttoned naval tunic with shoulder tabs, small gold shoulder decoration visible screen-left, a short blue/gold ribbon bar on screen-left chest and an oval red-edged gold anchor patch on screen-right chest. Preserve hairstyle silhouette, pose, badge placement, crop and original light gray painted background. Fit the closed collar to the mascot's short broad neck without adding a white belly patch.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up female officer facing slightly toward screen-left with gently closed lips and an enormous tall rounded oval black afro extending high above the forehead. Keep her actual tall hair silhouette, full black eyebrows, smooth upper lip/cheeks/chin and calm expression; no hat, glasses or facial hair. Blue-gray naval tunic with a closed standing collar, dark central throat/front buttons, gold shoulder ornaments, a gold wing-shaped badge on screen-left chest and red-edged oval gold anchor patch on screen-right chest. Maintain the broad shoulders, exact emblem placement without invented fine insignia, upper-left lighting and full pale gray-green painted backing. Use a compact broad yellow mascot face and very short neck integrated naturally with the closed collar.
